title: Red Outdoor Coleus - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Indoor/Outdoor Coleus
description:
Vibrant Foliage for Stunning Outdoor Displays


KEY FEATURES
• Stunning red foliage for dramatic garden impact
• Ideal for borders, containers, and hanging baskets
• Easy to grow and low maintenance
• Provides continuous colour throughout the growing season
• Versatile for various garden designs and planting schemes


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Houseplants — Plectranthus scutellarioides
Colour: Red (foliage)
Season: Summer to Autumn (foliage interest)
Growth Habit: Bushy, upright


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Partial shade to full shade
Soil: Well-draining, rich, moist soil
Watering: Keep soil consistently moist, especially during dry periods
Spacing: 20-30 cm apart
Height: 30-60 cm
Spread: 30-45 cm
Hardiness: H1C (Tender - requires frost protection)


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Upon arrival, pot the mini plugs into small pots with good quality compost.
• Gradually acclimatise plants to outdoor conditions over 7-10 days before planting out after the last frost.
• Pinch back growing tips regularly to encourage a bushier, fuller plant.
• Ensure consistent moisture; do not allow the soil to dry out completely.
• Protect from frost; treat as an annual in temperate climates or bring indoors over winter.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants


DISPATCH
Plants are carefully packed and dispatched Monday-Wednesday to avoid weekend delays.
